title: French Beans (Frasbean): modeled ₹796/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: January 2022: reported french Beans (Frasbean) prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 75% of 16 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹796 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 212 same-variety market pairs screened for french Beans (Frasbean) in January 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2022
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) (Himachal Pradesh) and Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported french Beans (Frasbean) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 16 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) reported a median ₹4,125 per quintal. Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹5,250 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹912/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹912 per quintal, and Kangra (Baijnath) was dearer on 88% of days.

scenes.headline: 150 km by road
scenes.caption: 150 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹32/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹311 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹89 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kangra (Baijnath) report, the rule selects 12 of 16 modeled shipping days. 12 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹796 per quintal (₹528 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled French Beans (Frasbean) route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 75% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹79,600, or ₹52,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹32/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled French Beans (Frasbean) route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 75% of matched days in January 2022.
